definitions.ask: Should dedicated Pomodoro Task Links in daily-note ledgers also wear the ring?
definitions.why: Every ledger row is a Task Link already, so a ring there adds noise but no new information.

choices.label: Ledger rows keep their 🍅 / ◐ / type-drift slot; only prose links in daily notes get rings
Every ledger row also wears a ring (◐ rows keep only ◐); status at a glance, one glyph per row

definitions.ask: Should links to Done or Cancelled tasks also dim their link text, not just show the closed ring?
definitions.why: The ring already says "closed"; leaving the link text alone keeps Obsidian's link styling intact.
